verses.text: After this, the word of the LORD came to Abram in a vision: "Do not be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, and your reward will be very great."
But Abram said, "Lord GOD, what can you give me, since I still have no children? The one who will receive everything I own is Eliezer of Damascus."
Abram went on, "You have not given me any children, so a servant born in my household will be my heir."
Then the word of the LORD came to him: "This man will not be your heir. A son who is your own flesh and blood will be your heir."
The LORD took Abram outside and said, "Look up at the sky and count the stars, if you can count them." Then he said to him, "That is how many your children and their children will be."
Abram believed the LORD, and the LORD counted that faith as making him right with God.
He also said to him, "I am the LORD, who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldeans to give you this land to own."
But Abram said, "Lord GOD, how can I know that I will own it?"
So the LORD said to him, "Bring me a young cow, a female goat and a ram, each three years old, along with a dove and a young pigeon."
Abram brought all these to him. He cut the animals in half and laid the halves opposite each other, but he did not cut the birds in half.
Birds of prey came down on the dead bodies, but Abram chased them away.
As the sun was going down, Abram fell into a deep sleep, and a thick and terrifying darkness came over him.

Then the LORD said to him, "You can be sure that your children and their children will be strangers in a country that is not theirs. They will be made slaves there and treated badly for four hundred years.
But I will punish the nation that makes them slaves, and afterwards they will come out with great wealth.
As for you, you will join your ancestors in peace. You will die at a good old age and be buried.
After four generations your people will come back here, because the sin of the Amorites has not yet reached its full measure."
When the sun had gone down and it was dark, a smoking fire pot and a blazing torch appeared and passed between the pieces of the animals.
On that day the LORD made a covenant with Abram. He said, "I give this land to your children and their children, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the Euphrates.
It is the land of the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites,
the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaites,
the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites and the Jebusites."
